questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: School zone ahead
questions.explanation: This pentagonal sign means you are near or entering a school zone or school crossing. Slow down and watch for children. Follow all posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers what they must do. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of an island or barrier. The road ahead is divided with traffic going both directions separated.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downgrade ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is coming. Check your brakes and be prepared for the downgrade.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: These parking spaces are reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disabled parking placards. Only those vehicles may park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you about multiple curves coming up on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: Red signs mean an action is prohibited. This sign tells you that you are going the wrong way. Stop and turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the road ahead ends at an intersection. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop. Then turn left or right as needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ends.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that the separated lanes are ending ahead. Get ready to change lanes or adjust your position on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign shows you which direction to drive. You must follow the direction of the arrow on this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slow-moving vehicle.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions immediately ahead. A speed advisory plaque on the sign tells you the safe speed to use.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging into your lane. Check your side and rear mirrors, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means slower drivers should use the right lane so the left lane stays open for passing and faster traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Activate your turn signal and proceed into traffic at the usual speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must wait for vehicles on the main road to pass before you go. You don't need to stop completely if no vehicles are coming, but you should slow down and proceed cautiously.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left only on a green arrow.
May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Must wait for the solid green light before you turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A sign that says "yield" means you must slow down and be ready to stop for any vehicle, bicyclist, or pedestrian. After yielding to them, you may follow the rest of the sign's instructions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red light like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Yield to all other traffic and pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign, traffic is moving toward you. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left or continue straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your lane splits into two directions. You may turn left or continue straight in a lane with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Yield sign.
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle is a yield sign. You must be ready to slow down or stop when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location. It is illegal and unsafe to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign. It tells you that the road splits ahead and you must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Be alert and stop if you see children crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for bicycles.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to watch for bicycles in the area. Be alert for cyclists crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turns.
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around at this location, especially where traffic flows in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrian crossing.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows a pedestrian crossing ahead. Be alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: There is roadwork ahead.
questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate construction. Slow down and be careful.
